PMID:10390358.access_scope: Complete authentic normal abstract and official reference identity read. Publisher full text/PDF returned 403 and bounded searches recovered no original full text; no original Methods, figure or assay-species claim.
PMID:10390358.biological_scope: The original authentic abstract links paracellin-1 to renal tight junctions and magnesium resorption. It supports the biological context but does not resolve the specific intracellular-cation assertion without the unavailable full text.

PMID:14628289.access_scope: Selected genuine normal full Methods, Results and Discussion read, including peptide, domain and MDCK assays. No figure pixels inspected.
PMID:14628289.biological_scope: Human CLDN16 terminal peptides bind ZO-1 PDZ domains, and HA-CLDN16 associates with endogenous canine ZO-1 in MDCK cells. T233R disrupts terminal binding and junctional targeting; the active human construct starts at the second historical methionine.

PMID:16234325.access_scope: The exact genuine normal abstract remains unchanged. Selected original author-uploaded indexed Methods and Results were recovered externally; historical construct and epithelial transport passages were inspected, not the complete paper or figure pixels.
PMID:16234325.biological_scope: Human and mouse constructs are tested in epithelial monolayers with dilution-potential and ion-substitution measurements. The active short human construct changes paracellular cation permeability, while the historical longer construct differs in localization.

PMID:16528408.access_scope: Selected genuine normal full Methods and Results read, including direct magnesium-flux measurement and wild-type/variant comparisons. No figure pixels inspected.
PMID:16528408.biological_scope: Wild-type human CLDN16 reaches MDCK-C7 junctions and increases directly measured magnesium permeability. Disease variants separate intracellular retention from impaired function despite junctional localization.

PMID:18188451.access_scope: Selected genuine normal full Methods, Results and Discussion read for human constructs, interactions, permeability and strand incorporation. No figure pixels inspected.
PMID:18188451.biological_scope: Human CLDN16 and CLDN19 interact and form a cation-selective junctional complex. CLDN16 alone does not produce fibroblast strands, but incorporates into CLDN19-containing strands; the LLC-PK1 selectivity results are model-specific.

PMID:19706394.access_scope: The exact genuine normal abstract remains unchanged. Selected original PMC full Methods and Results were recovered and read externally; no inaccessible supplement or exact modern isoform alignment is claimed.
PMID:19706394.biological_scope: Mouse knockdown experiments show reciprocal dependence of CLDN16 and CLDN19 junctional localization and renal divalent-cation handling. The interaction panel supports selective association; exact modern product boundaries are not newly reconstructed from the inspected text.

PMID:22373575.access_scope: Selected genuine normal full Methods, Results and Discussion read; mouse CLDN14 and human CLDN16/19 accessions are explicit. Four literal MINT records were inspected, three matching the original CLDN14 pair.
PMID:22373575.biological_scope: Explicit mouse CLDN14 and human CLDN16/19 constructs support CLDN14–CLDN16 two-hybrid and reciprocal coimmunoprecipitation results. CLDN14 reduces CLDN16-dependent cation permeability in LLC-PK1 cells; the older oligomer model remains assay-scoped.

PMID:28028216.access_scope: Selected genuine normal full Methods, Results and Discussion read for human tagged constructs, FRET, contact enrichment and separate rodent tissue/physiology. No figure pixels inspected.
PMID:28028216.biological_scope: Human fluorescent CLDN16/19 constructs show cis association and cooperative contact enrichment, with weak CLDN16 homomeric FRET. Mouse and rat TAL mosaics and mouse segment physiology are distinct from these heterologous human construct assays.

PMID:26446843.access_scope: Selected genuine normal full Methods and Results read for human constructs, complex association and permeability effects. No figure pixels or atomic structural determination claimed.
PMID:26446843.biological_scope: Human CLDN16/19 constructs form heteromeric complexes in cellular and detergent-extracted systems; interface perturbations couple association to junctional selectivity. The results do not determine an atomic native junctional structure or universal stoichiometry.

PMID:39821681.access_scope: Selected genuine normal full Methods, Results and Discussion read; dog constructs and endogenous-background controls retained. No human-specific construct assay or target FRET result inferred.
PMID:39821681.biological_scope: Dog CLDN16 and CLDN19 reconstituted in claudin-deficient MDCKII cells generate channels with substantial magnesium and calcium permeability. Endogenous CLDN16 and partner-dependent assembly are important controls; the separate CLDN4/8 FRET experiment is not assigned to CLDN16.

PMID:41325524.access_scope: Selected genuine normal full Methods, Results and Discussion plus the previously authenticated supplement Constructs text read. No new figure-pixel inspection; unresolved construct species/accession remains explicit.
PMID:41325524.biological_scope: Heterologous junctional models support replacement of CLDN16 by CLDN14 within CLDN19-containing structures, alongside mouse kidney observations. The inspected construct section does not explicitly identify every CLDN16 transgene species or accession; host-cell identity is not used as protein-species evidence.

definition.text: A lipid bilayer along with all the proteins and protein complexes embedded in it and attached to it.
The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of a complex.
Binding to a PDZ domain of a protein, a domain found in diverse signaling proteins.
Enables the transfer of magnesium (Mg) ions from one side of a membrane to the other.
The membrane surrounding a cell that separates the cell from its external environment. It consists of a phospholipid bilayer and associated proteins.
Binding to an identical protein or proteins.
The directed movement of substance through the space in between adjacent cells, rather than through the cells themselves.
Enables size- and charge-selective transport of solutes through a tight junction barrier paracellularly, across the epithelium.

An occluding cell-cell junction that is composed of a branching network of sealing strands that completely encircles the apical end of each cell in an epithelial sheet; the outer leaflets of the two interacting plasma membranes are seen to be tightly apposed where sealing strands are present. Each sealing strand is composed of a long row of transmembrane adhesion proteins embedded in each of the two interacting plasma membranes.
The directed movement of metal ions, any metal ion with an electric charge, into, out of or within a cell, or between cells, by means of some agent such as a transporter or pore.

A homeostatic process involved in the maintenance of a steady state level of monoatomic cations within a cell. Monatomic cations (also called simple cations) are cations consisting of exactly one atom.
The attachment of one cell to another cell via adhesion molecules that do not require the presence of calcium for the interaction.
The directed movement of magnesium ion across a membrane.

A renal system process in which water, ions, glucose and proteins are taken up from the collecting ducts, glomerulus and proximal and distal loops of the nephron. In non-mammalian species, absorption may occur in related structures (e.g. protein absorption is observed in nephrocytes in Drosophila, see PMID:23264686).
A cell-cell junction that seals cells together in an epithelium in a way that prevents even small molecules from leaking from one side of the sheet to the other.
The movement of substances between cells.

ontology.scope: GO:0015095 and GO:1903830 describe membrane crossing. GO:0160187 and GO:0160184 specify junctional paracellular passage. GO:0030001 includes movement between cells, so its refinement changes the specificity axis without alleging a false metal-ion role. No new process or ancestry relationship is manufactured.
